Right: its square, power(2), joins every pair at distance at most 2. It keeps the four path edges and adds three accent skip-one edges, A–C, B–D, and C–E, for 7 edges in all." width="100%"} The k-th power joins every pair of nodes whose distance is at most `k`. The square ($k = 2$) links friends of friends, which is how "two hops away" reach, interference between radio transmitters that share a neighbor, or distance-2 colorings are modeled; higher powers smooth a network into its k-step neighborhoods. The graph must be undirected. The result keeps every node (IDs, labels and attributes) and is simple and unweighted. ::: ## Parameters {.doc-parameters} ::: {.doc-definition-items} [k]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [int]{.doc-parameter-annotation} : The maximum distance (a positive integer). ::: ## Returns {.doc-returns} ::: {.doc-definition-items} [Graph]{.doc-parameter-annotation} : A new undirected graph with an edge for every pair at distance 1 to `k`. ::: ## Raises {.doc-raises} ::: {.doc-definition-items} [ValueError]{.doc-parameter-annotation} : If the graph is directed or `k` is not positive. ::: ## Technical Notes {.doc-technical-notes} A breadth-first search from every node, truncated at depth `k`, so $O(V(V + E))$ time in the worst case. Powers have striking structural guarantees: the square of every 2-connected graph is Hamiltonian (Fleischner, 1974), and the cube of every connected graph is (Karaganis, 1968; Sekanina, 1960). Matches NetworkX's `power`. ## Examples {.doc-examples} The square of a path of five nodes adds the "skip one" links: ::: {#e0c258fc .cell execution_count=1} ``` {.python .cell-code} import edgecase as ec path = ec.Graph().add_nodes(["A", "B", "C", "D", "E"]) path.add_edges([("A", "B"), ("B", "C"), ("C", "D"), ("D", "E")]) path.power(2).get_edges_str_repr(use_labels=True) ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=1} ``` ['A--B', 'A--C', 'B--C', 'B--D', 'C--D', 'C--E', 'D--E'] ``` ::: ::: Raising to the diameter gives a complete graph: ::: {#016dc07a .cell execution_count=2} ``` {.python .cell-code} path.power(4).count_edges() ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=2} ``` 10 ``` ::: :::
